verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              द्वारदेशे ततो द्रौणिमवस्थितमवेक्ष्य तौ। अकुर्वतां भोजकृपौ किं सञ्जय वदस्व मे॥१॥

सञ्जय उवाच।
              कृतवर्माणमामन्त्र्य कृपं च स महारथः। द्रौणिर्मन्युपरीतात्मा शिबिरद्वारमागमत्॥२॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said "Inviting Kritavarman as also the great carwarrior Kripa, Drona's son, worked up with rage, approached the gate of the camp.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भूतं महाकायं चन्द्रार्कसदृशद्युतिम्। सोऽपश्यद्द्वारमाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्तं लोमहर्षणम्॥३॥
verses.english: He there saw a being of huge frame capable of making the very hair erect and endued with the effulgence of the Sun or the Moon, guarding the entrance.

verses.sanskrit: वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं महारुधिरविस्रवम्। कृष्णाजिनोत्तरासङ्गं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम्॥४॥
verses.english: round his loins was a tiger-skin covered with blood, and he had a black deer for his upper garment. He had for his sacred thread a large snake.

verses.sanskrit: बाहुभिः स्वायतेः पीनैर्नानाप्रहरणोद्यतैः। बद्धाङ्गदमहासर्पं ज्वालामालाकुलाननम्॥५॥
verses.english: His arms were long and massive, and held many sorts of uplifted weapons. He had for his armlet a huge snake wound round his upper arin. His mouth was ablaze with flames of fire.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं व्यादितास्यं भयानकम्। नयनानां सहस्रैश्च विचित्रैरभिभूषितम्॥६॥
verses.bhavadeepa: बद्धाः महासर्पाः अङ्गदरूपा येन तम् अग्निज्वालाव्याप्तमुखं क्रुद्धमित्यर्थः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: नैव तस्य वपुः शक्यं प्रवक्तुं वेष एव च। सर्वथा तु तदालक्ष्य स्फुटेयुरपि पर्वताः॥७॥
verses.english: His body and his dress were beyond description. Upon seeing him the very mountains would split into a thousand pieces.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्य नासिकाभ्यां च श्रवणाभ्यां च सर्वशः। तेभ्यश्चाक्षिसहस्रेभ्यः प्रादुरासन्महार्चिषः॥८॥
verses.english: From those blazing flames of fire came out of his mouth and nose and ears and all those thousand of eyes.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तेजोमरीचिभ्यः शङ्खचक्रगदाधराः। प्रादुरासन् हृषीकेशाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥९॥
verses.english: From those blazing flames hundreds and thousands of Hrishikeshas came out armed with conchs and discs and maces.

verses.sanskrit: तदत्यद्भुतमालोक्य भूतं लोकभयङ्करम्। द्रौणिरव्यथितो दिव्यैरस्रवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥१०॥
verses.english: Seeing that extraordinary being capable of striking terror to the entire world, Drona's son, without any fear covered him with showers of celestial weapons. That being, however, devoured all those arrows discharged by Drona's son.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौणिमुक्ताञ्छरांस्तांस्तु तद्भूतं महदग्रसत्। उदधेरिव वार्योधान्पावको वडवामुखः॥११॥
verses.english: Like the Vadava fire devouring the waters of the ocean, that being devoured the arrows discharged by the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रसत्तांस्तथाभूतं द्रौणिना प्रहितान् शरान्। अश्वत्थामा तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य शरौघांस्तान्निरर्थकान्॥१२॥
verses.english: Seeing his arrowy showers prove fruitless, Ashvathaman discharged at him a long dart burning like fire.

verses.sanskrit: रथशक्तिं मुमोचासौ दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव। सा तमाहत्य दीप्ताग्रा रथशक्तिरदीर्यत॥१३॥
verses.english: That blazing dart striking against that being, broke into pieces like a huge meteor at the end of a cycle breaking and falling down from the sky after striking against.

verses.sanskrit: युग्मान्ते सूर्यमाहत्य महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता। अथ हेमत्सरुं दिव्यं खड्गमाकाशवर्चसम्॥१४॥
verses.english: Without losing a moment Ashvatthaman drew from its sheath an excellent sky-coloured scimitar having a golden hilt. The scimitar came out like a snake from its whole.

verses.sanskrit: कोशात्समुद्बबर्हाशु बिलाद्दीप्तमिवोरगम्। ततः खड्गवरं धीमान् भूताय प्राहिणोत्तदा॥१५॥
verses.english: The intelligent son of Drona then threw that excellent scimitar at that being. approaching that being the weapon disappeared within his body like a mungoose disappearing in its hole.

verses.sanskrit: स तदासाद्य भूतं वै बिलं नकुलवद्ययौ। ततः स कुपितो द्रौणिरिन्द्रकेतुनिभाङ्गदाम्॥१६॥
verses.english: Worked up with anger the son of Drona then hurled a blazing mace huge as a pole set up in honor of Indra. That being devoured that mace also.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलन्तीं प्राहिणोत्तस्मै भूतं तामपि चाग्रसत्। ततः सर्वायुधाभावे वीक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः॥१७॥
verses.english: At last, when all his weapons were exhausted, Ashvatthaman, looking around, saw the entire sky densely crowded with images of Janarddana.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यत्कृतमाकाशमनाकाशं जनार्दनैः। तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणपुत्रो निरायुधः॥१८॥
verses.english: Seeing that wonderful spectacle Drona's son, divested of weapons, recollected the words of Kripa, and burning with grief, said,-"He who hears not the beneficial words of friends, repents being overwhelmed with calamity, as does my foolish self for having disregarded by two well-wishers.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीदतिसन्तप्तः कृपवाक्यमनुस्मरन्। ब्रुवतामप्रियं पथ्यं सुहृदां न शृणोति यः॥१९॥
स शोचत्यापदं प्राप्य यथाऽहमतिवर्त्यतौ। शास्त्रदृष्टानविद्वान्यः समतीत्य जिघांसति॥२०॥
verses.english: That fool who, disregarding the way laid down by the scriptures, tries to kill his enemies, falls off from the path of righteousness and is lost in sin.

verses.sanskrit: स पथः प्रच्युतो धर्मात्कुपथे प्रतिहन्यते। गोब्राह्मणनृपस्त्रीषु सख्युर्मातुर्गुरोस्तथा॥२१॥
verses.english: One should not use weapons against kine, Brahmanas, kings, women, friends, one's own mother, one's own preceptor, a weak man, an idiot, a blind man, a sleeping man, a terrified man, one just got up from sleep, an intoxicated person, a lunatic, and one that is careless. The ancient preceptors always preached this truth to men.
verses.bhavadeepa: अतिवर्त्य अतिक्रम्य तौ तयोः कृपकृतवर्मणोर्वाक्यमिति शेषः। शास्त्रदृष्टान् अवध्यत्वेन शास्त्रे ज्ञातान् समतीत्य शास्त्रमुल्लङ्घ्य॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: हीनप्राणजडान्धेषु सुप्तभीतोत्थितेषु च। मत्तोन्मत्तप्रमत्तेषु न शस्त्राणि च पातयेत्॥२२॥
इत्येवं गुरुभिः पूर्वमुपदिष्टं नृणां सदा। सोऽहमुत्क्रम्य पन्थानं शास्त्रदृष्टं सनातनम्॥२३॥
verses.english: By neglecting the eternal way pointed out by the scriptures and by trying to follow a wrong path I have, however, fallen into a dreadful distress.

verses.sanskrit: अमार्गेणैवमारभ्य घोरामापदमागतः। तां चापदं घोरतरां प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥२४॥
verses.english: It is described by the wise as a terrible calamily when one through fear, cannot achieve a great feat after having tried to do the same.

verses.sanskrit: यदुद्यम्य महत्कृत्यं भयादपि निवर्तते। अशक्तश्चैव तत्कर्तुं कर्म शक्तिबलादिह॥२५॥
verses.english: By using my skill and power, I am unable to achieve that which I have promised? Human exertion is never more powerful than destiny.

verses.sanskrit: न हि दैवाद्गरीयो वै मानुषं कर्म कथ्यते। मानुष्यं कुर्वतः कर्म यदि दैवान्न सिध्यति॥२६॥
verses.english: If any action of a man that is undertaken becomes unsuccessful through destiny, the actor becomes like one who deviating from the path of virtue is lost in the wilderness of sin.

verses.sanskrit: सपथः प्रच्युतो धर्माद्विपदं प्रतिपद्यते। प्रतिज्ञानं ह्यविज्ञानं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥२७॥
verses.english: The wise describe defeat as foolishness when one having undertaken a task abandons it from fear.

verses.sanskrit: यदारभ्य क्रियां काञ्चिद्भयादिह निवर्तते। तदिदं दुष्प्रणीतेन भयं मां समुपस्थितम्॥२८॥
verses.english: For the wickedness of my attempt, this great calamity has befallen me, otherwise Drona's son would never had been compelled to hold back from battle.

verses.sanskrit: न हि द्रोणसुतः सङ्ख्ये निवर्तेत कथञ्चन। इदं च सुमहद्भूतं दैवदण्डमिवोद्यतम्॥२९॥
न चैतदभिजानामि चिन्तयन्नपि सर्वथा। ध्रुवं येयमधर्मं मे प्रवृत्ता कलुषामतिः॥३०॥
verses.english: Again this being, who is before me, is most wonderful. He stands there like the uplifted rod of divine punishment. Thinking much even, I Cannot recognise this being.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः फलमिदं घोरं प्रतिघाताय कल्पते। तदिदं दैवविहितं मम सङ्ख्ये निवर्तनम्॥३१॥
verses.english: Forsooth, that being is the dreadful outcome of this my sinful determination which I had attempted to achieve by unfair means, He stands there for baffling my resolution.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यत्र दैवादुद्यन्तमिह शक्यं कथञ्चन। सोऽहमद्य महादेवं प्रपद्ये शरणं विभुम्॥३२॥
verses.english: It seems, therefore, that my casing from fight had been ordained by destiny. It is useless for me to try to accomplish my resolution unless density becomes favorable.

verses.sanskrit: दैवदण्डमिमं घोरं स हि मे नाशयिष्यति। कपर्दिनं देवदेवमुमापतिमनामयम्॥३३॥
verses.english: I shall, therefore, at this hour, seek the protection of the powerful Mahadeva. He will remove this dreadful rod of divine punishment uplifted before me.

verses.sanskrit: कपालमालिनं रुद्रं भगनेत्रहरं हरम्। स हि देवोत्यगाद्देवांस्तपसा विक्रमेण च। तस्माच्छरणमभ्येमि गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्॥३४॥
